name: Alpha RV16AF 16 mm potentiometer
summary: The familiar full-size 16 mm single-gang panel potentiometer used for volume, synth and guitar controls; use a 7.2 mm bushing hole.
source: Taiwan Alpha RV16AF series documentation identifies this as the 16 mm metal-shaft family with metal-bushing options and several terminal orientations. The envelope and 7.2 mm clearance hole here cover the common RV16AF panel-mount version, but the exact bushing and anti-rotation tab differ by suffix. Verify the selected manufacturer's drawing before cutting.
